Generated individually with the built-in image tool. Original transparent PNGs remain unchanged; these WebP assets are optimized for avatar display.

characters.description: Warm welcoming HR coordinator, coral pink buttoned blazer, holding a small cream clipboard with a tiny heart icon and offering an open friendly hand. Gentle closed crescent smiling eyes.
Thoughtful business analyst, lavender buttoned blazer, small round purple spectacles, holding a tablet showing a simple teal line graph with no words. Bright attentive eyes and confident small smile.
Creative marketing teammate, mint green buttoned blazer, holding a small coral megaphone, playful delighted smile, one little lavender idea sparkle close to head. No spectacles.
Friendly sales consultant, apricot peach buttoned blazer over ivory shirt, carrying a small elegant dark navy garment shopping bag, other hand giving a welcoming wave. Cheerful wide smile.
Dependable operations colleague, warm navy blue buttoned blazer, carrying a small neatly packed cream parcel with a coral ribbon. Calm upbeat smile and neat posture.
Helpful IT teammate, powder blue buttoned blazer, holding a small open lavender laptop with a tiny gear icon on its lid, happy focused expression. No spectacles, no headset.
Careful accounting teammate, muted plum purple buttoned blazer, holding a small mint calculator with simple blank buttons and a cream ledger. Friendly bright eyes, pleased smile.
Resourceful finance teammate, teal green buttoned blazer, holding a little cream coin purse with two round gold coins, warm confident grin. No text or currency symbols.
Skilled suit tailoring colleague, ivory beige buttoned blazer with coral trim, a soft yellow measuring tape around shoulders and small coral fabric swatch in one hand. Warm smile, no sharp tools.

Encouraging team leader, dusty violet buttoned blazer over cream shirt, small golden compass brooch, holding a simple cream planning notebook and giving a supportive thumbs up. Joyful reassuring smile.
